East European Foundation Moldova: Impact Space 2024-2028

description.narrative: Initiativet, med titeln "Impact Space", är utformat för att skapa ett stödjande ekosystem för sociala företag, utrusta dem med nödvändiga verktyg, resurser och nätverk för att frodas och skapa meningsfull social påverkan.

The initiative, titled “Impact Space”, is designed to establish a supportive ecosystem for social enterprises, equipping them with the necessary tools, resources and networks to thrive and create meaningful social impact.

Overall objective/impact
Vulnerable women and men are more empowered and benefit from better employment opportunities provided by social enterprises.
Specific Objectives/outcomes:
The project will achieve four outcomes: Outcome 1. (Policy advocacy) The legal and policy frameworks on social entrepreneurship are improved Outcome 2. (Capacity building) Capacities of prospective and existing social entrepreneurs are strengthened Outcome 3. (Impact Fund for Social Entrepreneurship) Social entrepreneurs increasingly implement impact initiatives designed to facilitate employment and improve livelihoods of most vulnerable groups Outcome 4. (Impact ecosystem) Preconditions are in place to create a thriving ecosystem of social enterprises through the Impact Hub
